---
title: "Evidence standards"
---

<div class="phase-banner" id="phase">Join a session first.</div>

::: {#submit-box style="display:none"}
### Propose up to three standards
A standard is a rule the class would use to judge whether a study, or a body of studies, is credible evidence that an education technology changed student learning. One sentence each.
<ul id="mine" class="big-list"></ul>
<textarea id="std-text" rows="3" maxlength="400"></textarea>
<p><button class="primary" id="std-btn">Submit</button> <span id="std-count" class="meta"></span></p>
<div class="status" id="std-status"></div>
:::

::: {#vote-box style="display:none"}
### Vote for up to five
Every standard the class proposed is listed, in random order.
<div id="ballot"></div>
<p><button class="primary" id="vote-btn">Cast votes</button> <span id="vote-count" class="meta"></span></p>
<div class="status" id="vote-status"></div>
:::

::: {#final-box style="display:none"}
### The class's five standards
<ol class="big-list" id="final"></ol>
:::

<script>
(function () {
  const { rpc, store, el, status, watchSession } = Lab;
  let ballot = [];

  async function loadMine() {
    let mine = []; try { mine = await rpc("my_standards", { p_token: store.get().token }); } catch {}
    document.getElementById("mine").replaceChildren(...mine.map(m => el("li", {}, m.text, " ",
      el("button", { class: "secondary", style: "min-height:28px;margin-left:.5rem", onclick: async () => {
        try { await rpc("delete_standard", { p_token: store.get().token, p_submission: m.id }); loadMine(); }
        catch (e) { status(document.getElementById("std-status"), e.message, false); } } }, "remove"))));
    const left = 3 - mine.length;
    document.getElementById("std-count").textContent = left > 0 ? `${left} of 3 remaining` : "You have proposed three standards.";
    document.getElementById("std-btn").disabled = left <= 0;
    document.getElementById("std-text").disabled = left <= 0;
  }
  document.getElementById("std-btn").onclick = async () => {
    const st = document.getElementById("std-status"), ta = document.getElementById("std-text");
    try { await rpc("submit_standard", { p_token: store.get().token, p_text: ta.value }); ta.value = ""; status(st, "Submitted.", true); loadMine(); }
    catch (e) { status(st, e.message, false); }
  };

  function renderBallot(chosen) {
    const box = document.getElementById("ballot");
    box.replaceChildren(el("div", { class: "choice-group", style: "flex-direction:column" }, ...ballot.map(b => el("label", {},
      el("input", { type: "checkbox", value: b.id, ...(chosen.includes(b.id) ? { checked: "" } : {}), onchange: count }), el("span", {}, b.text)))));
    count();
  }
  function count() {
    const n = document.querySelectorAll("#ballot input:checked").length;
    document.getElementById("vote-count").textContent = `${n} of 5 selected`;
    document.getElementById("vote-btn").disabled = n === 0 || n > 5;
  }
  document.getElementById("vote-btn").onclick = async () => {
    const ids = [...document.querySelectorAll("#ballot input:checked")].map(i => +i.value);
    const st = document.getElementById("vote-status");
    try { await rpc("cast_votes", { p_token: store.get().token, p_submission_ids: ids }); status(st, `Recorded ${ids.length} vote${ids.length===1?"":"s"}. Resubmitting replaces them.`, true); }
    catch (e) { status(st, e.message, false); }
  };

  let lastPhase = null;
  watchSession(async sess => {
    document.getElementById("phase").textContent = Lab.PHASE_TEXT[sess.phase];
    document.getElementById("submit-box").style.display = sess.phase === "standards_submit" ? "" : "none";
    document.getElementById("vote-box").style.display = sess.phase === "standards_vote" ? "" : "none";
    document.getElementById("final-box").style.display = sess.phase === "final" ? "" : "none";
    if (sess.phase === "standards_submit" && lastPhase !== sess.phase) loadMine();
    if (sess.phase === "standards_vote" && lastPhase !== sess.phase) {
      ballot = await rpc("get_ballot", { p_join_code: sess.join_code });
      let chosen = []; try { chosen = await rpc("my_votes", { p_token: store.get().token }); } catch {}
      renderBallot(chosen);
    }
    if (sess.phase === "final") {
      const f = await rpc("get_final", { p_join_code: sess.join_code });
      document.getElementById("final").replaceChildren(...f.map(x => el("li", {}, x.text, " ", el("span", { class: "meta" }, `(${x.votes} vote${x.votes === 1 ? "" : "s"})`))));
    }
    lastPhase = sess.phase;
  });
})();
</script>
